scope: All 58 archived LP2 JPEG files and all 17 archived LP1 JPEG files
unit: complete stored JPEG byte, not decoded pixel or hexadecimal nibble
class_rule: For each file, count each byte value 00 through FF. A file is in the reported nonzero-mode class if its most frequent byte is not 00. Ties are reported explicitly.
encoding_check: Read the baseline JPEG SOF0 component count directly from the marker stream. One component and three components are separate header categories; neither is inferred from visual appearance.
zero_location_check: Count zero bytes before and after the first SOS header. This does not distinguish entropy bytes from any later marker bytes.
interpretation_limit: No randomness test, steganographic extraction, date code, source encoder attribution or author-intent claim.
